patterns.signal: A new best appears in the first few evaluations, followed by repeated baseline-like attempts.
patterns.default_action: Preserve best-so-far, add novelty/no-op detection, and use a measured plateau or branch policy.
patterns.avoid: Do not spend the next run only on more model calls or rewrite the evaluator.

patterns.signal: Most evaluations are zero, missing, failed, or have no usable pass rate.
patterns.default_action: Check environment, command, golden data, compile/runtime output, and score parsing before changing search policy.
patterns.avoid: Do not call this a difficult optimization landscape or keep repeating the same proposal family.

patterns.signal: Runner, Pi, debugger, and evaluator report materially different iteration or completion counts.
patterns.default_action: Instrument lifecycle events and make zero-iteration/silent-success paths explicit failures.
patterns.avoid: Do not optimize middleware, compaction, or prompts until accounting is reconciled.

patterns.signal: The same baseline score dominates the candidate series.
patterns.default_action: Check whether candidates actually differ; then add candidate fingerprints and no-op/duplicate suppression.
patterns.avoid: Do not infer that a stable score means convergence unless a new best was observed.
